name: Ilhan Omar
description: Follow Ilhan Omar, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: DOJ seized Rep. Omar's phone, subpoenaed family members in immigration status investigation
changes.summary: Federal agents seized Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar’s phone when they searched her Washington, D.C., home as part of a federal investigation into potential immigration-related crimes. NBC News' Kelly O'Donnell reports on the subpoenas sent in the case, including to members of her family.

changes.title: Justice Dept. Issues Subpoenas in Ilhan Omar Investigation
changes.summary: After years of investigation, the Justice Department appears to be intensifying a criminal inquiry into the immigration history of Ilhan Omar, a Minnesota Democrat, and her family.

changes.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
changes.summary: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home. (Image credit: Alex Wong).

changes.title: Rep. Omar accuses Trump of political intimidation after agents search her home
changes.summary: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C., home of Minnesota Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar early Monday. Agents with Homeland Security Investigations were seen carrying boxes from the home. Rep. Omar accused the Trump administration of political intimidation. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Devlin Barrett, a.

changes.title: Omar’s home searched as part of federal criminal investigation
changes.summary: Federal agents carried out a search warrant on Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar’s home in Washington as part of a federal criminal investigation. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.
